bill_id.description: The bill it was recorded from, whose files hold the tax agent's advice.

nature_of_payment.description: The nature of payment it is for.

note.description: Why, in the tax agent's words.
examples: Non-resident professional working on site in Singapore: 15% of gross

outcome.description: not_applicable: nothing is withheld; withhold: at the rate the tax agent advised; treaty: a reduced treaty rate, with the certificate of residence attached.

rate_percent.description: The rate withheld, as a percentage of the payment before GST; absent for not_applicable.

recorded_at.description: When it was recorded: it is in force from then.

tax_agent.description: The tax agent who gave it.
